verdict.rationale: A training-data opt-out or no-training policy is a fair privacy question for a cloud platform that hosts customer workloads and AI agents, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no policy, setting, or statement about Fly.io using or not using customer data for AI model training. Hardware-isolated VMs, egress locking and encrypted secrets are adjacent security controls and do not address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
